mensajes.admin_comprobar_correcto: The proposal matches the catalogue and preserves its requirements.
mensajes.admin_comprobar_limite: File check only. It does not publish the profile or grant access. Validity and provenance are checked against the supplied files.
mensajes.admin_comprobar_entrada_invalida: Check the files and the validation date. They must contain the expected data, without unknown or repeated fields.
mensajes.admin_catalogo_acciones_invalido: The catalogue is incomplete or contains invalid data.
mensajes.admin_propuesta_perfil_invalida: The profile proposal is incomplete or contains invalid data.
mensajes.admin_perfil_fijo: This system profile can only be viewed. Changes are not allowed.
mensajes.admin_catalogo_acciones_no_vigente: The catalogue is not valid on the specified date.
mensajes.admin_origen_perfil_no_coincide: The source version or hash does not match. Check the catalogue version and the previous profile version.
mensajes.admin_permiso_perfil_no_coincide: A permission does not match its valid entry. Check the action, resource, purpose, fields, assurance and obligations.
mensajes.admin_gobierno_plan_preparado: The plan is ready. No version has been published and no permissions have changed.
mensajes.admin_gobierno_plan_limite: File-based plan. Publication or withdrawal requires an administrative identity, a central source, another approver and a durable record.
mensajes.admin_plan_gobierno_perfil_invalido: The plan cannot be prepared. Check the operation, the previous version, its validity control and the reason.
